title: The Emergent Symbolic Structure of Artificial Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.29530v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern systems in artificial intelligence (AI) somehow excel in domains for which they seem poorly suited. Intelligence has traditionally been modeled as operating over structured combinations of symbols, such as logical formulas. However, the strongest modern AI systems are based on neural networks, which instead represent information in continuous vectors. Vectors seem inadequate for capturing the structure of language, logic, and other cognitive domains, yet neural networks achieve impressive performance in these areas. How do they do it? In this work, we propose a potential answer: Despite appearances, perhaps the internal representations of neural networks implicitly realize symbolic structure. translated_title: 人工神经网络的涌现符号结构
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）的现代系统在某种程度上在它们似乎并不适合的领域中表现出色。智能传统上被建模为对符号的结构化组合进行操作，例如逻辑公式。然而，最强大的现代AI系统是基于神经网络的，它们以连续向量而非符号来表示信息。向量似乎不足以捕捉语言、逻辑和其他认知领域的结构，但神经网络却能在这些领域取得令人瞩目的表现。它们是如何做到的？在本工作中，我们提出了一个可能的答案：尽管表面上并非如此，但神经网络的内部表示可能隐式地实现了符号结构。为支持这一假设，我们证明多种神经网络的向量表示可以被符号结构紧密逼近：我们可以用一个封闭的符号结构替换网络整个表示生成过程……
tldr: 该论文提出神经网络的内部向量表示实际上隐式地实现了符号结构，并通过证明多种神经网络的向量表示可被符号结构紧密逼近，解释了神经网络为何能在语言和逻辑等领域表现出色。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes that the internal vector representations of neural networks implicitly realize symbolic structure, demonstrating that the vector representations of various neural networks can be closely approximated by symbolic structures, thereby explaining their impressive performance in domains like language and logic.
